name: Battle of the Catalaunian Plains
note: The site of the battle is disputed, and the plan follows the account of Jordanes as modern scholars read it, chiefly Hughes. The accounts do not say which way the ridge ran, so it is drawn across the plan with the allies on one side and Attila's army on the other. The accounts do not say where Attila's camp lay, so it is placed behind the Hunnic line on the right-hand side. Placing the Gepids opposite the Romans and the Amali Goths opposite the Visigoths follows the order of the fighting in the account. Hughes places Thorismund between the Alans and the Visigothic main body, while MacDowall places him on the far right. Other scholars hold that the account is distorted and that the outcome was indecisive.

terrain.name: The ridge
terrain.quote: the Catalaunian plain rose on one side by a sharp slope to a ridge

units.name: Roman army, left of the line
units.quote: Then Aetius's Romans arrived on the left side of the ridge

units.name: Alans, in the centre
units.quote: Aetius placed the Alans in the centre of the formation

units.name: Thorismund's Visigoths
units.quote: he places Thorismund between the Alans and Visigothic main body

units.name: Visigoths, right of the line
units.quote: the Visigoths held the right side, the Romans the left

units.name: Gepids, Hunnic wing
units.quote: repulsed the Gepids as they came up

units.name: Huns, centre of the line
units.quote: the Huns deployed in the centre, with their vassals on the wings

units.name: Amali Goths, Hunnic wing
units.quote: whilst leading his own men against the enemy Amali Goths

units.name: Attila's wagon camp
units.quote: Attila was forced to seek refuge in his own camp, which he had fortified with wagons.

phases.title: The two armies deploy along the ridge
phases.text: Both sides spent the day deploying their coalition armies. Attila's Huns stood in the centre with their vassals on the wings, while the Romans took the left, the Alans the centre and the Visigoths the right.
phases.quote: both sides spent the entire day carefully deploying their coalition armies.

phases.title: Attila's forces take the right of the ridge
phases.text: Attila's forces reached the ridge first and held its far right side, before the Visigoths could take that position. The Amali Goths stood forward on the ridge there.
phases.quote: Attila's forces arrived on the ridge first, on the far right side, before the Visigoths could take that position.

phases.title: The Romans take the left and repulse the Gepids
phases.text: The Romans then arrived on the left side of the ridge and drove back the Gepids as they came up, so that the Romans held the left side of the ridge.
phases.quote: Then Aetius's Romans arrived on the left side of the ridge, and repulsed the Gepids as they came up.

phases.title: The Alans and Thorismund secure the centre
phases.text: The Alans and the Visigoths under Thorismund fought their way up the ridge and took its centre, which they held against Attila.
phases.quote: Finally the Alans and the Visigoths under Thorismund fought their way up and secured the centre of the ridge, holding it against Attila.

phases.title: The Visigoths try to take the right of the ridge
phases.text: Theodoric led his Visigoths against the Amali Goths on the right. He was killed in the assault, and the rest of his army did not know of his death.
phases.quote: Theodoric, whilst leading his own men against the enemy Amali Goths, was killed in the assault without his men noticing.

phases.title: Thorismund drives back the Hunnic centre
phases.text: Thorismund found Attila's place in the Hunnic line and attacked the Hunnic centre, nearly killing Attila. The Hunnic centre was forced to retreat.
phases.quote: attacked the Hunnic centre, nearly slaying Attila himself and forcing the Hunnic centre to retreat.

phases.title: Attila withdraws into his camp
phases.text: The Hunnic centre fell back, and Attila was forced to seek refuge in his own camp, which he had fortified with wagons.
phases.quote: Attila was forced to seek refuge in his own camp, which he had fortified with wagons.

phases.title: Thorismund enters the camp by mistake at night
phases.text: When night fell, Thorismund, returning towards friendly lines, entered Attila's encampment by mistake and was wounded in the fighting there.
phases.quote: Thorismund, son of king Theodoric, returning to friendly lines, mistakenly entered Attila's encampment.
